title: object-shorthand consistent-as-needed crashes linting after last object-shorthand rule update

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
**Tell us about your environment**
- **ESLint Version:** 3.7.1
- **Node Version:** 5.12.0
- **npm Version:** 3.8.6

**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?** default

**Please show your full configuration:**

``` json
{
  "plugins": [],
  "env": {
    "browser": true,
    "es6": true,
    "node": true
  },
  "parserOptions": {
    "sourceType": "module",
    "impliedStrict": true,
    "ecmaVersion": 6,
    "ecmaFeatures": {
      "experimentalObjectRestSpread": true
    }
  },
  "rules": {
    "object-shorthand": ["error", "consistent-as-needed"]
  },
  "globals": {}
}
```

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

<!-- Paste the source code below: -->

``` js
const x = {};
const y = { ... x };
```

**What did you expect to happen?**
Eslint should finish its job of linting specified files.

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**
